card.name: Give-verbs in historical prose
card.fires_on: Forms of the verb give (gave, given, giving) in older historical or scholarly narrative, often followed by an object like attention, instruction, way, up or rise. Also fires occasionally on similar verbs such as had or brought.

modes.label: Give-verb forms
modes.description: Gave, given or giving in phrases like give up, give way, give rise, give instruction.
modes.example: During the last ten years of his first residence at Athens, Aristotle<< gave>> instruction in rhetoric

modes.label: Other narrative verbs
modes.description: Occasional other verbs or words in historical accounts that precede an event or object.
